criteria.statement: Step-table tests: named step adds its summary under PHASE GUIDANCE in Quick Lookup, at most three, in turn order; none when no step is named
Each corrected step-summary fact has a test
Excerpt tests: rule-book order, grouped labels from part titles, each id once, lead-in added where needed
Every lead-in with a list arrives with it; the 12,000-character budget holds; overflow line fires on 0 corpus cases
Curated manifest includes 117.3a-d and 400.7 sub-rules as topic rule numbers and the REQ-179 data test passes
Pointer tests: at most ten resolved pointers, first sentence capped at 250 characters
REQ-238, 239, 240, 244, 022, 024 and rules-section parts of layout and assembly docs applied by intent
Each golden prompt change is reviewed and listed in the evidence log
